subject: [PATCH 2/3] mm/swap: account synchronous swap reads as memory stall

reviews.author: Kairui Song
reviews.summary: Reviewer Kairui Song tested the patch on top of V1 and found it worked well, suggesting no need to move functions but offering to send a revised version (V2) including their changes while retaining the original authorship.

2026-11-03.patch_summary: This patch accounts for synchronous swap reads as memory stalls by modifying the folio_wait_bit_common function to trigger delay accounting and PSI (Pressure Stall Information) when a page is locked, not up-to-date, and in the working set.

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner (author)
reviews.summary: Author explained their design choice to keep the write side in the same sequence, removing redundancy in swap_add_folio(), and confirmed it's easier for readers.
reviews.raw_body:
I did that to keep the write side in the same sequence, and remove the
then fully redundant submission in swap_add_folio(). Seems a bit
easier on readers that way.

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch accounts for synchronous swap reads as memory stalls by modifying the folio_wait_bit_common function to trigger delay accounting and PSI (Pressure Stall Information) when a page is locked, not up-to-date, and in the working set.
